summary.text: John Thune is a U.S. Senator from South Dakota and the Senate Majority Leader; he won his Senate seat in 2004 and was elected to a fourth term in 2022.

paragraphs.text: He represented South Dakota in the U.S. House of Representatives for three terms after first winning election in 1996.
He grew up in Murdo, South Dakota, and earned his undergraduate degree at Biola University and an MBA at the University of South Dakota.
He lives in Sioux Falls with his wife, Kimberley.
